head.text: WF-037 Secondary sample point with a loop delay longer than the data bit

foot.text: Data bit 4 quanta, loop delay 6 quanta (longer than a bit), offset 2: the delay is measured at the edge from FDF to res (clock 8 to 14). The transmitted bit is compared with the received bit at the secondary sample point, 8 quanta after the start of the transmitted bit, i.e. after the end of that bit; the received value at the normal sample point is ignored by the transmitter (REF-002 transceiver delay compensation).
